in_hebrew.name: אדה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Adah means noble, mighty, or precious. It is derived from the Hebrew root 'adah' which means 'to flow'. In the Bible, Adah is mentioned as one of the wives of Lamech (Genesis 4:19).

in_greek.name: Αδά
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Adá is derived from the Hebrew name Adah. It means noble, mighty, or precious. In ancient Greece, Adá was not a common name and there is no known mythological figure with this name.

in_latin.name: Adalina
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Adalina is derived from the Hebrew name Adah. It means noble, mighty, or precious. Adalina was not a common name in ancient Rome and there is no known Roman goddess or mythological figure with this name.
